warnings: Roof beam + steel roof-framing plan (hip roof, eave 2.20 all round). RC roof beams: R7 on rows A and D, R8 / R8/1 on grids 1 and 12 (bottom level = R7, three steel posts LG.☐100x100x3.2mm. on each R8), R9 / R10 on grids 3, 4, 9, 10 (top of beam = top of column). T-marks typed truss.
'R7/R7' in the stair bays 3-4 / 9-10 and 'T4/R9' on grids 3/4/9/10 B-C are stacked labels; each recorded as two members on one segment with a lowered score.

[2026-10-19, superseded 2026-10-22/23: the T2 hips, their dashed continuations and the unlabelled x 2.00/3.00 (41.00/42.00) lines are now recorded - see the last warning; the eave-overhang lines and the lone R6 label are still open] PARTIAL: the T2 hip members are NOT recorded - they run diagonally from each eave corner through the corner columns to (2.00, 2.00) / (2.00, 8.50) (mirror 42.00 at grid 12), ends that sit on no grid line, with a dashed continuation to grid 2/11; also not recorded: the unlabelled steel lines along x 2.00/3.00 (41.00/42.00) between the hips, the unlabelled eave-overhang lines on grids 3/4/9/10 beyond rows A/D, and a lone 'R6' label in bay 5-6 near row C that marks no visible member. Shutdown deadline - left for a later pass rather than guessed.
T3 is printed only in the two end bays; the same continuous heavy ridge line (B' 5.25) across bays 2-11 is recorded as T3 with a lower score.
T1 recorded as one member per grid line, eave to eave (14.90), since a truss is not split at its bearing beams; small square supports drawn on each T1 at row C.
Scale text not read; the plan measures 1:125 like S-01..S-03 - left null rather than claimed.

2026-10-22/23 resume: ADDED the hip framing that the 2026-10-19 pass left out (24 entries, appended at the end of elements[] rather than re-sorted, to keep the existing entries untouched): at each of the 4 corners the T2 hip in two atomic segments - eave corner to the corner column (A'1'-A1, D''''1'-D1, A'12''-A12, D''''12''-D12) and corner column to where the heavy T2 line stops on the printed x line 1''''' 2.00 / 11'' 42.00; plus the unlabelled dashed continuation of each hip toward grid 2 / 11 (upper ones end on B2 / B11), the unlabelled heavy line along x 2.00 / 42.00 joining the two hip ends, and the unlabelled dashed line along x 3.00 / 41.00 (A'''''' to B''''''). All diagonals carry span_length_m null + span_source 'unresolved' + flag 'diagonal' (section 4: a diagonal span is never scaled; precedent house 102). The hip ends sit at y 2.00 and 8.50 on the 45° hip, but no y dimension is printed there, so NO dummy y line was created and those ends are null with the missing line named in missing_line (rule: an off-grid end stays unresolved, never invented). Not added (still open): the unlabelled eave-overhang lines on grids 3/4/9/10 beyond rows A/D, and the lone 'R6' label in bay 5-6.

2026-10-23 op04 resume CORRECTION: the 4 T4 entries (grids 3, 4, 9, 10) were recorded B-C 4.00 only, from where the stacked 'T4/R9' label is printed. S-16 (หน้า28) draws T4 as one truss eave to eave (2.20 | 2.50 | 4.70 | 3.30 | 2.20 = 14.90, R7 at both rows), and on this plan the line on those grids runs from eave to eave exactly like the T1 lines (which this file already records A' to D'''' with the label printed once). So each T4 is now A' -> D'''' 14.90 (flag extent_from_S-16_elevation). This also accounts for the 'unlabelled eave-overhang lines on grids 3/4/9/10 beyond rows A/D' that the 2026-10-19 pass listed as open - they are T4's eave portions. Risk: if T4 were meant only between R9 supports, steel is over-counted by 10.90 m per truss; S-16's full-width elevation makes that unlikely.
